'''Tumble Weed''' was the name of a [[makrin creeper]] that lived on [[Makeb]] until [[3639 BBY]], when it was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tumble Weed appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Makeb. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
